record.name: Datadog
record.one_liner: Monitoring and security platform for cloud applications providing infrastructure and application telemetry.
record.access_note: Sign up for a free trial on Datadog's website and generate API and application keys in the dashboard.
record.api_note: Extensive HTTP REST API covering metrics, logs, traces, monitors, dashboards, and organization management.

evidence.quote: Requests that write data require reporting access and require an API key.
The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API.
Go to Tools > AI Assistant > Model Context Protocol (MCP)
